summary: Advanced Filters for Admin Notifications
text: Added advanced targeting filters to admin notifications: round table tags, types, tracks and names, and activity filters such as incomplete profiles or no meeting requests. Organisers can target notifications at participants by session participation, profile completeness and meeting or round table activity, with thresholds.

summary: Advanced Filters for Campaigns
text: Added advanced campaign filters by session, round table and exhibitor event attributes, profile completeness and meeting programme activity. Organisers target emails at users with incomplete profiles, no topic selections, no meeting requests, low opt-ins or low mutual matches.

summary: Please add badge BAR & QRcode variable for Campaigns
text: Added Badge Bar Code and Badge QR Code variables to the Campaigns standard variables list. Campaign emails show each recipient's internal or external badge barcode and QR code, scannable by the check-in app.

summary: Additional tasks to Campaign redesign (2nd iteration)
text: Delivered a second round of campaign redesign: tag-style variables, a variable settings pop-up, a sender details section and clearer stats rows. Organisers see variables as tags, edit their settings from a gear icon and return to the list with a 'Campaign successfully saved' notice.

summary: Campaigns refresh (1st iteration)
text: Redesigned the Campaigns list and campaign page: empty state, filters, back button, statistics buttons and clearer setting names. Organisers use a refreshed campaigns area matching the Admin Panel Fixes design.

summary: Hide Export data if there was no send-out
text: Hid Export data for campaign send-outs that haven't happened yet. Export data appears only for completed send-outs.

summary: Campaigns refresh (2nd iteration)
text: Refreshed Campaigns: unsaved-changes and empty-template warnings, no auto-filled dates, campaign duplication, an Apply button, recommended buyer settings, save notices, sorting and statistics. Admins are warned before leaving or saving empty templates, can duplicate campaigns, sort by creation date, and see send and open stats from the list.

summary: EMEA: Header of chat is fixed on the web version
text: Made web chat windows minimisable to a header tab, with unread-message badges and a maximum of three windows. Clicking a chat header collapses it to a 360×63 tab at the bottom of the page; collapsed tabs show unread counts and expand on click.

summary: Limits on creating chats
text: Added a rate limit on starting new chats, sent via sockets and applied on iOS and Android for all users and events. Users who exceed the limit (300 new chats per day as of 22 October) are blocked from new chats and told when they can try again.

summary: [portalUI] add ability to click on the notification in the notification dropdown menu
text: Made notifications in the dropdown menu clickable to open the related profile or session. Users jump from a notification to its subject.

summary: Comments and Likes functionality v.1.1 (Live comments and Replies) || Feed & Groups
text: Added live mode and replies to comments in Feed & Groups. Comments update live and users can reply to comments.

summary: Increase the character limit for the short description in groups from 200 to 400
text: Raised the character limit for community group short descriptions from 200 to 400. Group short descriptions can be up to 400 characters, allowing clearer descriptions.

feature: Company and job title on user cards
summary: Enhancing User Card Information with Company Name & Job Title (WEB)
text: Updated participant card layouts across the web platform, including community, team members, meetings, messenger, profiles and sessions, to show company name and job title. User cards across the web frontend consistently display company and job title per the updated designs.

feature: Company and job title on user cards
summary: Enhancing User Card Information with Company Name & Job Title (APP)
text: Updated participant card layouts across the mobile app to show company name and job title. User cards in the app show company and job title where the profile has them, leaving empty space otherwise.

summary: Create setting for using custom SMPT service
text: Added a setting to send platform emails through a custom SMTP service. Registration, meeting, message, campaign and reminder emails can use a custom SMTP server.

summary: Variables for Email Campaigns
text: Added email campaign variables for admin and user details, meeting program counts (relevant, pending, unaccepted, rejected, limits) and assigned round tables. Organisers can schedule campaign emails that show each recipient's meeting statistics, limits, assigned round tables and admin contact.

summary: Email campaign is not sent out to multiple recipients
text: Enabled the Campaign tool to send mass email campaigns of over 1,000 messages to filtered recipients in one action. Campaigns reach all selected recipients without duplicates, which can be checked in the campaign stats.

summary: Implement templates for all events
text: Made the six email nurturing campaign templates default for every event, old and new, with default banner and footer. Every event has six ready campaign templates in its template list.

summary: Recommended exhibitors variable redesign
text: Redesigned the recommended exhibitors email variable as an Outlook-compatible block with profile, meeting, message and favourite actions. Emails show recommended exhibitors with clickable actions that respect meeting and messaging permissions, limits and the permission matrix.

summary: Recommended Products variable redesign
text: Redesigned the Recommended Products email variable with clickable product cards and Meeting, Message and Favourite buttons. Emails show the recommended products from the frontend, linking to product profiles and meeting, messenger and favourite actions, respecting permissions and module settings.

summary: Recommended Sessions variable redesign
text: Redesigned the Recommended sessions email builder variable as session cards with track, image, speakers, date and sponsors, respecting category visibility. Campaign emails show the configured number of recommended session cards linking to the session page, hiding sessions the recipient cannot see.

summary: Recommended News variable redesign
text: Redesigned the Recommended News email variable to the Email Nurturing design, including only approved news visible to the recipient's category. Campaign emails show the admin-set number of recommended news cards, linking to the news page and rendering in Outlook, Apple Mail and Gmail.

summary: Variables with pictures and value
text: Added picture-card email variables for event totals (exhibitors, products, meeting requests) and the receiver's views, meetings and chats. Emails can show live counts as of the send date, matching the analytics dashboard, even when related modules are off or a value is zero.

summary: Incoming meeting variable
text: Upgraded the Incoming meetings email variable to show linked meeting cards with attendee icons, date, location and local time. Campaign emails show the configured number of incoming meetings, linking to My Schedule, or an empty state when there are none.

summary: Incoming messages variable
text: Created an 'Incoming messages' email variable showing up to four latest unanswered chats with name, date and a two-line preview. Emails preview unanswered chats linking to the messenger, show a placeholder when there are none, and omit the card if messaging is off.

summary: Variable for moving to profile
text: Added a PROFILE_URL email template variable that links to /newfront/profile/dashboard with autologin, attachable to any template element. Email recipients can click a linked element, such as a button, to land logged in on their profile dashboard.

summary: Decrease the size of the incoming messages variable
text: Made the incoming messages email variable more compact: one line of message, date closer to sender. The incoming messages block matches the email nurturing design.

summary: View of the cards in the emails
text: Fixed product and exhibitor cards in emails: no underline, left-aligned names, buttons on the right, sponsor icons with a count. Email nurturing cards match the design.

summary: Adjust the outlook of the variable
text: Refined meeting and message email variables: tighter spacing, truncated names, two rows on mobile, real attendee photos. Incoming meeting and message blocks look right on desktop and mobile.

summary: Add Activation link variable in email sender
text: Added the 'Activation Link' variable to Marketing > Email sender, usable as a link or attached to buttons. Email sender recipients can click the link to open their frontend profile, which is activated immediately.

summary: Implement Registration Emails Template Save Confirmation Popup
text: Extended the unsaved-changes warning and the save confirmation notification from Campaigns to the other admin email template editors. Leaving an email template page with unsaved edits triggers a warning, and saving shows a success notification, across six template areas.

summary: Able to add team members to group chat
text: Listed an exhibitor's team members first, under a 'Team members' divider, when creating or adding to a group chat. Exhibitors add team members to group chats from the top of the list; search results show everyone together.

summary: Filter for the search query in Group tab
text: Showed the active search term and filters as chips on the Groups tab. Groups show what the user is searching or filtering by.

summary: Possibility to insert the Badge Bar Code & Badge QR Code variable to Buyer Accept email template.
text: Added Badge Bar Code and Badge QR Code variables to the Buyer Accept email template. Organisers can insert the buyer's badge barcode and QR code into Buyer Accept emails and run buyer communications within Hosted Buyer.

summary: Information Request email template for participants
text: Added a Participant Information Request email template and a Send Information Request button in participant profiles and the participants list menu. Organisers can email a participant a request for missing registration information, with an optional custom message inserted into the template.

summary: Leader board | Change the text of the tooltips
text: Rewrote the Leader dashboard tooltips for average interaction metrics. Tooltips explain each average clearly.

summary: Setting for determining the number of messages
text: Added a setting for how many messages, up to ten, appear in the incoming messages email variable. Organisers choose how many messages appear in nurturing emails.

summary: Messenger. Conversation status filters
text: A Conversation Status filter in Messenger: All, Two-way (both sides have written) or One-way (only one side has). Users filter their chats by reply status, combined with the existing filters.

summary: New filters for Messenger
text: Added two Messenger filters on web: 'Who initiated a chat' and 'Personal chats by meeting' status. Users filter personal chats by initiator and by meeting status; Incoming and Pending options are hidden when meeting auto-confirm is on.

summary: Multilanguage Admin Notifications
text: Added a language switcher to Admin Notifications so admins write the title and message per language, with a primary fallback language. Web users receive admin notifications in their profile language and app users in their device language, falling back to the primary language.

summary: Multi-Language Email templates - Marketing
text: Added a language selector to Marketing Email Sender and Campaign template creation and editing, so templates can be set per language. Marketing emails go out in each recipient's pre-selected language, with the default language used for recipients who have none.

summary: Multilanguage Admin Notifications (for non-logged-in user)
text: Extended multilanguage admin push notifications with a Non-Logged In App Users option, with landing rules by URL and app access type. Organisers can push notifications to app users who are not logged in; taps open the given page or home, or the login screen when access is closed.

summary: Networking Filters for Attendee and Exhibitor Lists (chat filter))
text: Added 'Existing Chat' filters to delegate, speaker, buyer, exhibitor, pavilion and product lists, configurable in admin display filters. Users filter lists to people or exhibitors they have messaged or who messaged them (OR logic); filters are off by default.

summary: Networking Filters for Attendee and Exhibitor Lists
text: Added 'Existing Meetings' and 'Existing Meeting Status' filters to delegate, speaker, buyer, exhibitor, pavilion and product lists, controlled in Display filters. Users filter lists by who initiated meetings and by meeting status, with team members' meetings counted for their exhibitor.

summary: Admin notification filters adjustment
text: Showed the Meeting Program and Round Tables 'Additional filters' block in Admin > Notifications only when the Meeting Program module is on. The additional notification filters are hidden unless the Meeting Program module is enabled in Module Management.

summary: Personal Assistant Improvement
text: Added a 'Personal Assistant Email' field to participant registration that copies all participant emails to that address. Emails to participants, buyers and team members are CC'd to the assistant's address when the field is filled in.

summary: Messenger mobile view (web)
text: Reworked the mobile web private chat page: back-to-list button, pinned header and input, hidden footer, and send-button-only messaging on mobile. On mobile the chat has a fixed header and input with Enter adding a new line; the desktop hint now reads 'Press Enter to send'.

summary: Organizer sees recommendation blocks with full-width layout and clear boundaries in email templates within an Event
text: Brought organizer Campaign email recommendation blocks up to the visitor-side standard with clear boundaries and full-width card layouts, so event emails look consistent and professional. Each recommendation block now has a consistent boundary and its cards use the full block width across Exhibitors, Products, News and Sponsors, on desktop and mobile, with no change to recommendation logic.

summary: Extending the List of Available Variables for Registration Email Templates
text: Extended the variables for registration email templates to all system and custom registration form fields, grouped as General, System Fields and Custom Fields. Visitor, speaker, moderator and exhibitor registration emails can include any registration field value.

summary: Segmentation of Push Notifications
text: Extended admin push notifications with advanced profile filters and targeting by session, exhibitor event, type, track or tag in users' schedules. Admins send notifications to users matching profile attributes or who have particular sessions or events in their schedule.

summary: Possibility to adjust time of Session reminder push notification
text: Added a 'Notifications Before Session/Exhibitor Event Start (mins)' multi-select, replacing hardcoded 60/30/15/10-minute reminders. Reminders go out at the configured minutes (0–60) on web and app, none if empty, and are resent if the start time changes.
